topic: Finding the pre-tip bill from a total paid amount
core_question: You pay $96 total for a brunch after adding a 20% tip. What was the bill before the tip, in dollars?
answer_summary: the pre-tip bill of $80 ($96 total including a 20% tip)
persona: impatient and curt; using casual slang

messages.content: hey so i paid 96 bucks for brunch but i tipped 20% on top. gotta figure out what the actual bill was before i left

yeah it includes the tip. i'm tryna calculate it quick cuz the receipt is confusing and i wanna make sure they didn't mess up the math

Makes sense - so if the $96 is the final amount after you added the tip on top, and the tip was 20% of the original bill, how would you think about the relationship between the bill and what you actually paid? Would the tip be 20% of the bill amount or 20% of the $96?
